mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_connection_status ( account_id, last_heartbeat_at, last_sync_at, last_police_phone_id, version, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{receivedAt}, #{lastSyncAt}, #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, 1, #{receivedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET last_heartbeat_at = GREATEST(account_connection_status.last_heartbeat_at, EXCLUDED.last_heartbeat_at), last_sync_at = GREATEST(account_connection_status.last_sync_at, EXCLUDED.last_sync_at), last_police_phone_id = EXCLUDED.last_police_phone_id, version = account_connection_status.version + 1, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ia.incident_id FROM incident_assignment ia JOIN incident i ON i.id = ia.incident_id AND i.status = 'OPEN' WHERE ia.account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY ia.incident_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type, a.organization_type, ia.incident_id, cs.last_heartbeat_at, cs.last_sync_at, COALESCE(cs.version, 0) AS version FROM incident_assignment ia JOIN account a ON a.id = ia.account_id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.account_type IN ('TEAM', 'PATROL_CAR') LEFT JOIN account_connection_status cs ON cs.account_id = a.id WHERE ia.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.id ASC
